xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: With respect to SCN in form DRC 01 under section 73(5) was served on 19/09/2025, pertained to short payment of tax and excess Input Tax Credit (ITC) availed/utilized amounting to Rs 31,74,980/-, along with interest of Rs 22,56,236/-, penalty of Rs 3,17,498/-, and late fees of Rs 1,80,200/- as mentioned in the notice.A reply to the SCN was submitted on 17 October 2025, stating that the demand pertains to the CIRP (Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process) period. Accordingly, a request was made to the department not to initiate any further proceedings in respect of the said demand.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The matter is under the jurisdiction of the State Tax Officer. The Company has submitted its reply on 17.10.2025.
